## PolCom Section at ECPR Krakow

::: section
![](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/issues/2025/12/img/Krakow_sq.png){.newsimg width="180"}

The programme for our section, [**"Political Communication Between Disruptive Technologies and Democratic Backsliding,"**](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/SectionDetails/1677) at the ECPR General Conference 2026 in Krakow (8–11 September) is now live. Across nine panels, papers address AI and platform governance, disinformation, election campaigning, authenticity and emotion, media trust, migration discourse, polarization, and political communication in war and conflict. All panels meet in person at the Faculty of International and Political Studies (Ground Floor, Room 08).

| Date | Time (CEST) | Panel |
|---|---|---|
| Tue 08/09 | 09:00–10:45 | [Platforms, Algorithms, and Information Control](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17545) |
| Tue 08/09 | 11:15–13:00 | [Conspiracy Narratives and Elite Communication](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17538) |
| Tue 08/09 | 14:00–15:45 | [War, Conflict, and Information Politics](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17541) |
| Tue 08/09 | 16:15–18:00 | [Migration, Intolerance, and Moral Boundaries](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17542) |
| Wed 09/09 | 11:15–13:00 | [Authenticity and Emotions](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17540) |
| Wed 09/09 | 16:15–18:00 | [Elections, Campaigning, and Political Advertising](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17544) |
| Thu 10/09 | 09:00–10:45 | [Disinformation, Falsehoods, and Democratic Resilience](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17537) |
| Thu 10/09 | 11:15–13:00 | [Political Alignment, Identity, and Polarization](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17546) |
| Thu 10/09 | 16:15–18:00 | [Media, Trust, and Democratic Accountability](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/17536) |

Room, date and time for the Standing Group **Business Meeting** and the [ECR Mentoring Session](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/PanelDetails/18012) are still to be announced.

See the full section overview, abstracts and paper listings here:

[View section details](https://ecpr.eu/Events/Event/SectionDetails/1677){style="background-color:#000000;color:#ffffff;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;"}

:::

## ECPR Joint Sessions - Reach out For Workshop Endorsement

::: section

The call for the ECPR Joint Sessions of Workshops, taking place at the **University of Trieste, 1–4 June 2027**, is now open. The deadline for submissions to ECPR is **15 September 2026**..

Each Standing Group may endorse one workshop proposal. If you are putting together a workshop proposal that fits the scope of Political Communication, send it our way by **end of August 2026** — we will review submissions and endorse the strongest one on behalf of the Standing Group.

[Read more](https://ecpr.eu/Events/369){style="background-color:#000000;color:#ffffff;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;"}

:::

## Vacany: Postdoctoral Researcher at U Namur

::: section

The Research Institute Transitions at **University of Namur** invites applications for a two‑year postdoctoral position on the ERC‑funded project *POLSTYLE — New trends or old habits? Stability and changes of political styles since 1960*, coordinated by **Prof. Jeremy Dodeigne**. POLSTYLE maps long‑term changes in political communication, combining comparative analysis with cutting‑edge NLP methods.

Ideal candidates hold a PhD in comparative politics with strong interests in political communication, democratic erosion, or party politics, and will develop an independent research agenda within the project. The position is based in **Namur, Belgium**, and starts **1 or 15 October 2026**. Apply by sending a single PDF (cover letter, research report, CV, and three referees) to polstyle@unamur.be.

**Deadline: 15 August 2026**

[Job Offer](https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/jobs/449343){style="background-color:#000000;color:#ffffff;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;"}

[Download Job Description](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/issues/2026/08/doc/job_Postdoc_erc_Polstyle_UNamur2026.pdf){style="background-color:#000000;color:#ffffff;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;"}

:::


## CfP: Beyond Fragmentation? (AssoComPol Annual Conference)

::: section

The Italian Association of Political Communication (AssoComPol) invites submissions to *Beyond Fragmentation? Contemporary Forms of Belonging Between Ideology and Narrative*, its annual conference exploring new modes of political-cultural belonging amid fragmentation, polarization, and digital mediation. Topics include political culture, online communities, journalism, platforms and AI, and methods for studying cultural transformation.

The conference takes place **10–12 December 2026** in **Perugia, Italy**, hosted by the University of Perugia and the University for Foreigners of Perugia. Submit extended abstracts (5000 characters) by **16 September 2026**; notifications follow **10–12 October**, with full papers due **30 November 2026**.

Deadline: **16 September 2026**

[Download CfP](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/issues/2026/08/doc/CfP_Call_AssoComPol26_EN.pdf){style="background-color:#000000;color:#ffffff;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;"}


:::

## Input for Next Newsletter

::: section

If you have any news you would like to share in the **next newsletter** of the ECPR Standing Group on Political Communication, please send it to [daniel.thiele@fu-berlin.de](mailto:daniel.thiele@fu-berlin.de?subject=ecpr-polcom-input) by **August 15th, 2026.**

This may include calls for papers or abstracts, event announcements, vacancies relevant to the political communication community, or recent publications by our members (peer-reviewed articles or monographs).

[Send us your input!](mailto:daniel.thiele@fu-berlin.de?subject=ecpr-polcom-input){style="background-color:#000000;color:#ffffff;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block;"}

:::
